a.text: Cairns remained with the Eastern Fleet until January 1945.

b.text: Colombo was her base of operations until January 1945.

a.text: Cairns was involved in the Allied invasion of Sicily.

b.text: The ship received the battle honour Sicily 1943.

a.text: A convoy Cairns was assigned to was attacked by Japanese submarine RO-110.

b.text: The corvette was involved in the successful destruction of the submarine.

a.text: The ship was transferred to the Indonesian Navy.

b.text: The ship was renamed KRI Banteng.
